theorem putnam_1964_a4
(u : ℕ → ℤ)
(boundedu : ∃ B T : ℤ, ∀ n : ℕ, B ≤ u n ∧ u n ≤ T)
(hu : ∀ n ≥ 4, u n = ((u (n - 1) + u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) * u (n - 4)) : ℝ) / (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ∧ (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ≠ 0)
: (∃ N c : ℕ, c > 0 ∧ ∀ n ≥ N, u (n + c) = u n) := by
  obtain ⟨B, T, hB⟩ := boundedu
  let f := fun n => (u n, u (n + 1), u (n + 2), u (n + 3))
  have hf : ∀ n, f n ∈ Set.Icc (B, B, B, B) (T, T, T, T) := fun n =>
    ⟨⟨(hB n).1, (hB (n + 1)).1, (hB (n + 2)).1, (hB (n + 3)).1⟩,
      (hB n).2, (hB (n + 1)).2, (hB (n + 2)).2, (hB (n + 3)).2⟩
  obtain ⟨i, j, hij, he⟩ := (Set.finite_Icc _ _).exists_lt_map_eq_of_forall_mem hf
  have h : ∀ m, f (i + m) = f (j + m) := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero => exact he
    | succ m ih =>
      simp only [f, Prod.mk.injEq, Nat.succ_eq_add_one, Nat.add_assoc, Nat.reduceAdd] at ih ⊢
      refine ⟨ih.2.1, ih.2.2.1, ih.2.2.2, ?_⟩
      apply Int.cast_injective (α := ℝ)
      rw [(hu (i + (m + 4)) (by omega)).1, (hu (j + (m + 4)) (by omega)).1]
      simp (disch := omega) only [Nat.add_sub_assoc, Nat.reduceSub, Nat.add_zero]
      rw [ih.2.2.2, ih.2.2.1, ih.2.1, ih.1]
  refine ⟨i, j - i, Nat.sub_pos_of_lt hij, ?_⟩
  intro n hn
  convert (congrArg Prod.fst (h (n - i))).symm using 1 <;> congr 1 <;> omega
